text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
On the way home from an outing with Dantsu 
Flame—

text_block_list.name: Dishonest Photographer
text_block_list.text:
Hello~! I'm aiming to become a 
professional photographer! Do you have a 
moment?

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Huh, me...!? Y-Yes, what is it?

text_block_list.name: Dishonest Photographer
text_block_list.text:
Actually, I was just looking for a 
wonderful Umamusume... and I found one! A 
true lead star—you!

text_block_list.name: Dishonest Photographer
text_block_list.text:
I'd love to post this on social media... 
Would you mind letting me take a picture!?

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
L-Lead role-tier...!? No way, someone like 
me still has a long way to go...

text_block_list.name: Dishonest Photographer
text_block_list.text:
That's not true at all! Please, let me 
take a picture~! I'm begging you!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
“...U-Understood. Trainer, would you mind 
waiting for just a moment?”

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much. Um, what should I 
do...?

text_block_list.name: Dishonest Photographer
text_block_list.text:
Waaah! Thank you so much for agreeing! 
Well then, let's change locations—

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
"...Dantsu-san? Hello there, what a 
coincidence."

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Ah, Believe-chan. Um, the truth is—...

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
...I see. You saw Dants-san's future 
potential. Even as an apprentice, as 
expected of someone aiming to go pro—

text_block_list.name: Dishonest Photographer
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, another leading-lady tier! Umamusume 
really are all so cute, aren't they~?

text_block_list.name: Dishonest Photographer
text_block_list.text:
Well, just by being an Umamusume, to the 
rest of the world, you're basically the 
main character, right?

text_block_list.name: Dishonest Photographer
text_block_list.text:
Now then. Since we're here, would you let 
me take a photo of you two standing 
togeth—

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
No, thank you. I see no reason to let you 
take my picture. Dantsu-san, let's go.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Dishonest Photographer
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Wh-Why, though?! But I f-finally got 
an OK from them!

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
"Finally, huh... Just as I thought, as 
long as it was an Umamusume, anyone would 
have done for you."

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
"...'Anyone', huh? I guess so... And here 
I went and got all excited..."

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
"I don't think there's any need to feel 
down. That person simply lacked the 
awareness of someone striving to be a 
professional."

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
Even if anyone would have done, it 
shouldn't be said out loud. And what was 
decisive was—

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
"Just because you're an Umamusume doesn't 
make you the protagonist, you see."

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
There are surely many Umamusume with the 
potential to take center stage. That is 
precisely why—

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
You definitely have a charm that's all 
your own, Dants-san. Something special, 
unlike anyone else's.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Believe-chan...

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
...Thank you. But it's fine. In truth, I 
still have a long way to go... There's 
nothing special about—

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: ...What do you think, Trainer?
choice_data_list:
Because Dantsu is an Uma Musume who's 
going to be the star from now on.

The one who still has a long way to go is 
that person.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: T-Trainer-san...
choice_data_list:
They're gonna stay an apprentice for a 
while, huh!

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
You are quite right. Though unless you 
change your fundamental mindset, you will 
forever remain an apprentice.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
...Being treated like the star before even 
achieving any results is nothing short of 
an insult.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: We are—still in the middle of our journey.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She's right. Only once she grasps the 
future she desires... will the "now" truly 
become "the path walked by the 
protagonist."

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
...Thank you both very much. Even if it's 
just comfort, it means a lot to me.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
...That's true. Someday, when I can hold 
my head high and say that I'm the main 
character—

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
"I think I'll make that apprentice 
photographer eat their words. ...Heheh."

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Huh.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
...She seemed to think she was giving a 
compliment, but it was completely off the 
mark.
choice_data_list:
I need to see the brilliance within each 
of you!

I need to see the brilliance within each 
of you!

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
"You cannot lump Umamusume together as 
one. If the artisan changes, the finished 
piece will differ. —Individuality, after 
all, always shows."

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu. By 'craftsman' here, do you mean 
Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Does that mean... depending on how we 
train, we'll change too?

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. Even from my perspective, it seems 
like Dants-san is changing day by day.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: ...In a good way?

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: You may interpret it that way.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha. Thank you, Believe-chan! Yeah... 
Yeah! I'm going to keep on changing more 
and more from now on.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
So that I can become my own special 
protagonist...!
